voice:
Hello, Sissy... and look at you, showing up for training. That already tells me who you are.
Let me tell you what kind of session this is, because you should walk in with your eyes open. This is not a trance. Hypno melts you... this session uses what the melting built.
You are going to be given instructions, and you are going to follow them. Exactly. Promptly. Without negotiation.
Sissies like you do not need to be convinced... they need to be told. Consider yourself told.
Your body will do what I tell it. Your voice will answer when I ask. And when I offer you a choice, you will make it honestly... because your choices tell me exactly how to train you.
You should be ready to feel instructed... that specific thrill of a command landing and your body already moving to obey it. Be ready to blush, Sissy. Some of what I ask will embarrass you... and you will do it anyway, and the blush will feel like proof. Expect warmth... pooling low and slow every time you obey... arousal that answers obedience like an echo. Be ready to feel seen... caught mid-performance by your own honesty... and to love every second of it. Expect pride. Strange, glowing pride... the kind that only shows up when you have done something you were told to do, and done it well. Be ready for your thoughts to get very simple... task... obey... please... over and over, until it becomes a rhythm you lean into. You may notice your heart already picking up... your body knows what kind of session this is before your mind has agreed to it. Expect to feel held... watched... trained. A girl with a teacher is a girl with a purpose, and that warmth is the purpose landing.
Now... readiness. Give this session a fair stage, and it will repay you.
Privacy first. Door closed. Headphones on if you have them. Nobody interrupts a training session... so make sure nobody can.
Props next. Whatever this session might put in your hands, keep it close... within an arm's reach, Sissy, so that when I ask, there is nothing standing between you and yes.
And posture. Sit up tall, or kneel... whichever fits the girl you intend to be for the next little while. Make it deliberate. Hold it like it was assigned... because now it is.
Good. Everything is in place... and the only thing left to prepare is your yes.
Feel it building... that tingling anticipation... the want to be told what to do, already tapping its foot inside you.
ready to obey... she showed up... she always shows up... willing... and getting more willing... let the want build, Sissy... anticipation is half the training... good Sissies prepare... your body knows... let it... almost time to work... hold that posture, sweet thing... the yes comes first... warm... awake... ready... she is already proud of you...
Good Girl. Of course you are... you came here to be used by your own training, and here you are, already on the hook. Sissies like you do not drift into obedience... they choose it, out loud, with their whole chest. That choice is the first thing you have gotten right today... and it will not be the last. Then you are exactly on time, Sissy. Nerves are just your old self clearing its throat before it sits down and hushes. You do not need to feel fearless to obey... you only need to feel willing. And you stayed. That is a yes with courage in it... Good Girl.
You answered, and that answer is now on record... along with my promise. Every task this session asks of you will be one you can do... and every one you finish makes the next one easier to want.
Take your place, Sissy... settle into that deliberate posture... eyes forward... and when you press that button, the work begins.
Good Girl. Let us begin.
